cases.name: Jessie Marietta Blodgett
cases.about: Her Find-a-Grave said "She graduated Hartford Union High School in 2012, and attended UWM in 2013. Jessie had just accepted a distinguished Talent Scholarship from the School of Music Education, as well as a campus job mentoring disadvantaged inner city university students. She was extremely proud of her new business; teaching 28 young Hartford students voice, piano, and violin lessons. She also volunteered every summer at the Central Middle School Orchestra summer program. Jessie was a fierce advocate for male against female violence, social justice, sustainable living, and environmentalism. Recently, Jessie played the fiddler with the Hartford Players in Fiddler on the Roof. She will be deeply missed by her family, friends, fellow students and all who knew her."
